cases.scenario: SIGKILL before/after project file fsync, receipt fsync, rename, destination-directory fsync
cases.expect: Only complete hash-verified candidates offered; staging retained but not offered; no silent durability claim after fsync error

cases.scenario: Editor command throws after partial graph mutation; native write pending/unknown; slider gesture still active
cases.expect: No committed autosave admission until proven settled transaction; dirty flag alone insufficient

cases.scenario: Root and virtual copies sharing one source, private people associations, inactive named versions, undo/redo, accepted generated masks
cases.expect: All canonical identities and all immutable assets survive; unsupported value blocks rather than drops

cases.scenario: Switch A→B→A while snapshot capture or write active; close panel during request
cases.expect: Old epoch cannot publish; pointer/composition pauses checkpoint; stale results cannot mutate new view; unknown mutation queried, not resent

cases.scenario: ENOSPC, reserve exhaustion, quota limit, permission denial, corrupted candidate, unreadable original
cases.expect: Visible blocked state; dirty state retained; no automatic cleanup or replacement of last good version

cases.scenario: Old schema migration, failed validation, concurrent original edit, future schema
cases.expect: Exact verified backup before migration; original remains byte-identical; newer schema rejected

cases.scenario: Source missing/moved, same size new content, tail-only change, full-hash unavailable
cases.expect: Explicit full-hash review; relink only identical source into a new candidate with all linked IDs and aliases retained; no stale-mask rendering

cases.scenario: Restore into existing directory; discard twice; recover trash; restart after uncertain restore
cases.expect: No overwrite; no permanent delete; inspect persisted candidate/destination instead of repeating unknown write

cases.scenario: Large project beyond 64 MB capture budget / 256 MB serializer budget; many snapshots
cases.expect: Bounded admission and visible backpressure; no ignored assets; no unbounded pending queue

cases.scenario: Application shutdown with queued and inflight autosave
cases.expect: Cancel invalidates uncommitted write; committed versions retained; shutdown does not claim flush/save; retain dirty-close confirmation

cases.scenario: New native protocol has unrecognized terminal result; direct EngineHandle send outside ordinary AppState dispatch
cases.expect: Native receipt fence pauses capture until reconciled; no empty-receipt assumption

cases.scenario: Copy-import provenance and receipts, private people scopes, FacePrecompute masks/landmarks, source aliases through crash restore
cases.expect: Exact codec roundtrip; no inference replacement or omitted immutable asset

cases.scenario: Crash after operation-started, destination creation, restore serialization or operation-result fsync
cases.expect: Persistent unresolved operation visible; no automatic replay; original and candidate remain intact

required_local_evidence: full project serializer roundtrip with real immutable assets
